payload.authorization: 2026-09-15 user explicitly authorized the zero-oracle compositional structural-subgoal generator milestone and its AGENTS.md entry
payload.scientific_problem: Learn a local molecular graph distribution that can synthesize executable structural patches on held T4 sources after whole-patch retrieval recovered zero held-source patches.
payload.primary_model_output: An address-free source-region distribution pi(R|x), followed by one conditional autoregressive distribution over a complete local target patch H, attachments alpha and construction dependencies D.
payload.central_claim_under_test: A split-first source-balanced joint local-patch generator can produce novel, exactly realizable held-source structural deltas from generic executor-supported atom and bond domains without storing or retrieving complete training patches.
payload.evaluation_setting: Three frozen whole-source folds over 77 T4 complete routes, 15 source groups and 147 teacher subgoals. Exactly converted Full-146 and PMO routes are training-only auxiliary domains and never enter the held T4 evaluator.
payload.causal_ablation: Learned balanced region and joint-event densities versus uniform scoring under identical legal fibers, localization rule, beam and output cutoffs.

split.t4_auxiliary_rule: admit Full-146 applications only when their origin source belongs to the T4 training fold
split.pmo_rule: admit only routes that the immutable v1 converter reconstructs exactly; keep PMO training-only and separately labelled

generated_object.region: The address-free set of source roles referenced by the first local construction event.
generated_object.target_patch: The complete before-to-after graph delta extracted after one or two mutually local generic construction events.
generated_object.attachments: Every generated source-to-created or created-to-created target edge, emitted inside the same event sequence.
generated_object.dependencies: Ordered created-role and shared-role dependencies induced by the same event sequence, not a separately predicted label.

model.region_features: address-free element, degree, bond, cycle and global graph summaries
model.joint_event_features: one vector containing rule, all relative structural operands, typed parameters, current graph, selected region, prior event and partial-patch state
model.event_support: all exact legal Active8 successors admitted by the unchanged generic executor fiber; no finite whole-patch vocabulary
model.locality: after the first event, later events must reference the fixed source region or a role created or changed by the partial patch
model.fit: closed-form weighted diagonal Gaussian moments with a fixed variance floor; no neural accelerator training
model.weights: equal domain mass; within domain equal source or task-family mass; within source equal route mass; within route equal component and decision mass
model.checkpoint_contents: numeric moments, generic support/configuration and input hashes only

decoder.uniform_tie_break: canonical successor key then action serialization

evaluation.teacher_injection: not used; if added later it must be a separately labelled rank diagnostic

acceptance.learned_improvement_gate: At K=32 or K=128, the learned arm must strictly improve the uniform arm on source-balanced held-teacher component coverage or transformation-equivalent recall, with no loss of exact-realization precision.

payload.negative_result_policy: A failed improvement or teacher-recovery gate remains an authoritative negative result and does not authorize support expansion or scored calls.
payload.interpretation_limit: This gate establishes only zero-oracle held-source generated structural support. It does not establish molecular utility, docking improvement, autonomous optimization or an IVG comparison.
